scripts.deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build && node scripts/cloudflare.mjs opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.upload: opennextjs-cloudflare build && node scripts/cloudflare.mjs opennextjs-cloudflare upload
scripts.db:reset:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "DELETE FROM seats; DELETE FROM events;" && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/cloudflare.mjs wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:seed:remote: node scripts/cloudflare.mjs wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file seed/seed.sql
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:int && npm run test:ui
scripts.staging:deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build && node scripts/cloudflare.mjs opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env staging
scripts.staging:db: node scripts/cloudflare.mjs wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging && node scripts/cloudflare.mjs wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --env staging --command "DELETE FROM seats; DELETE FROM events;" && node scripts/cloudflare.mjs wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --env staging --file seed/seed.sql
